## Brand Strategy
- **Mission:** Make people's working lives simpler, more pleasant and more productive.
- **Vision:** A world where organizations can achieve agility easily, no matter their size.
- **Challenge/Solution/Result framework:** Challenge = organizational coordination; Solution = replace email with connected conversations, information and software; Result = everyone does their best work.
- **Brand values:** Empathy, Playfulness, Courtesy, Solidarity, Craftsmanship, Thriving.
- **Persona:** "Deliberately human" -- smart, humble, hardworking, collaborative. An ideal colleague who doesn't dominate conversation, never wastes time, knows the answer and context.
- **Brand philosophy:** "Our culture turned inward creates our product; our culture turned outward creates our brand."

## Logo
- **Octothorpe:** Composed of simple geometric shapes (speech bubbles and lozenges) in four primary colors on a 19x19 grid. Legible at most sizes with a small version for micro applications.
- **Logo:** Octothorpe + logotype set in Hellix Bold. Horizontal (primary, most instances) and stacked (large-scale only).
- **Small use logo:** Specific version for 50px-90px wide. Small mark for 15px-20px tall. Horizontal only.
- **Background rules:** Full-color logos on white, black, or aubergine only. One-color (black or white) on photographs and color backgrounds within the Slack palette.
- **Misuse rules:** No cropping, distortion, transparency changes, shadows/effects, color shuffling, typeface changes, different colors, outlining, size/position changes, rotation.
- **Brand architecture:**
  - External: Full Slack logo (builds equity).
  - Internal programs: Logo mark only (individuality within Slack).
  - Adjacent brands: Unique logos using Slack logo font + speech bubble for linkage.
  - Master brand offerings: Logo + program name in Hellix Light, separated by distance "A."
  - Partnerships: Logo lock-up with partner; octothorpe-sized clear space with divider line; partner logos baseline-aligned.

## Typography
- **Headline typeface:** Larsseit -- 12 weights (Thin through Extrabold, with italics). Optical kerning, tracking 0, sentence case only (no all-caps or all-lowercase). Web: -1px letter-spacing (small) / -2px (large).
- **Body typeface:** Slack Circular -- 8 weights (Book through Black, with italics). Optical kerning, tracking -10, title or sentence case. Web: 0px (normal) / -0.2px (hero).
- **Type specimen hierarchy:**
  - H1: Larsseit Bold 36/38
  - H2: Larsseit Bold 24/28
  - H3: Larsseit Bold 18/21
  - H4: Larsseit Bold 12/15
  - P: Circular Book, Style Set 2, 7/9
  - Hero P: Circular Book 10/14
  - Pull Quote: Larsseit Thin 18/21 with Circular Book 36pt quote mark
  - CTA: Circular Bold, +20 tracking, 7/9
- **Localized languages:** Japanese (Noto Sans / M PLUS 1p, 15% smaller than English). Portuguese, Spanish, French, German (10% smaller, allowing 20-30% more characters).

## Color
- **Core colors:**
  - White: #FFFFFF
  - Black: PMS Black / #1D1C1D
  - Aubergine: PMS 261 / #4A154B
  - Blue: PMS 298 / #36C5F0
  - Green: PMS 2250 / #2EB67D
  - Yellow: PMS 7409 / #ECB22E
  - Red: PMS 214 / #E01E5A
- **Usage proportions:** Text in black, white, or aubergine only. Blue, green, yellow, red as accent colors in prescribed proportions.
- **Secondary colors:** 28 additional colors organized in families (deep reds/pinks, oranges, yellows, greens, teals, blues, grays, warm neutrals). Each with PMS, CMYK, RGB, HEX values.
- **Secondary rules:** Not for text. Only white (#FFFFFF) or black (#1D1C1D) text over secondary backgrounds. Limited use with core colors.
- **Accessible combinations:** Documented passing contrast standards. Note: small blue text on aubergine fails accessibility (use for headlines only).

## Graphics
- **Octothorpe elements:** Speech bubble and lozenge shapes extractable for use as graphic elements.
- **Illustrations:** Reflect Slack personality: human, approachable, smart. Can be witty but never silly.
- **Icons:** Used across marketing, environment, and product. Symbolism, conceptual clarity, visual interest in simple shapes. Categories: Roles, Miscellaneous, Events.

## Photography
- **Spectrum:** Relatable to Aspirational.
  - Avatars: Relatable, human, warm, quirky (not silly), colorful but mature, personable.
  - Still life: Attainable, clear, concise, human, simple (not overly complex). Demonstrates Slack personality.
  - Lifestyle: Aspirational, alludes to collaboration, confident, environmentally inclusive (subject as part of something bigger).
- **Video:** Lower thirds in Larsseit Bold (names) + Slack Circular Book (titles), 80% opacity backgrounds. All videos end with Slack logo. Watermarks: upper left, 50% opacity.

## Applications
- Not extensively documented as separate section. Design elements and governance sections cover usage.
- **Master brand offerings:** External programs locked up with logo.
- **Governance section:** General terms, trademarks, website/application visual design, trade dress, merchandise, use requirements.

## Tone of Voice
- **Voice characteristics:** Confident (never cocky), witty (never silly), conversational (always appropriate), intelligent, friendly (not ingratiating), clear/concise/human, helpful (never overbearing).
- **Core principle:** "Characterful but never let character overwhelm content. What we have to say is infinitely more important than being admired for the way we say it."
- **Language rules:**
  - No cheap words or Silicon Valley cliches/jargon.
  - No describing people as "ninjas" or "rock stars" unless they literally are.
  - No pop culture references or exclusionary terms.
  - No "Slacker/Slacking/Slackee" as official terms.
  - No exclusionary, ableist, or misgendering language.
  - Value perspicuity above all. Contractions are your friend.
- **Slack usage:** "Slack" used as adjective only. Not noun, verb, plural, or possessive.
- **Brand voice philosophy:** "We are authentic. We like the people we're talking to. We're proud of what we're talking about."

## Outliers
- Extensive governance section (trademarks, trade dress, merchandise, legal terms) is unusually detailed for brand guidelines -- reflecting Slack's position as a widely-licensed/integrated product.
- Speech bubble and lozenge shapes extracted from octothorpe as standalone graphic elements -- symbol deconstruction as design system.
- Localized font sizing rules (Japanese 15% smaller, Romance languages 10% smaller) show rare attention to international typographic needs.
- Explicit ban on specific language patterns ("Happy Slacking!") and Silicon Valley jargon is distinctive.
- Style Set 2 specified for Circular body text -- a highly specific OpenType feature requirement.
- Brand architecture distinguishes external vs. internal use of full logo vs. mark -- pragmatic for a high-growth tech company.
- "Our culture turned inward creates our product; our culture turned outward creates our brand" is an unusually philosophical brand statement.

## Quality Score
**4 / 5** -- Strong, well-articulated brand guidelines with exceptional voice and tone documentation that goes beyond typical guidelines into genuine philosophical territory. The color system is comprehensive with accessibility guidance. Typography hierarchy is precise. Loses a point for limited layout/grid specifications, no explicit photography direction beyond three-category spectrum, and relatively light illustration guidance. The governance section adds practical value for a platform brand.
